view-01.png.evidence: White wings remain recognizable even at high density.
view-01.png.regressions: Large translucent circles hide the deck and indicators; wake is a rectangular slab.

view-02.png.evidence: Thin silhouettes and deck details survive crowded action; several plane shadows separate height.
view-02.png.regressions: Sea flecks and combat flecks have similar scale, with aircraft partly behind HUD.

view-03.png.evidence: Fine broken crests give the deep blue water scale against the carrier and distinguish the soft stern wake.
view-03.png.regressions: Bow aircraft still sits against deck markings and the broad offshore wave direction repeats.

view-04.png.evidence: Compact dark contacts keep the coastal tree crowns attached to the grass and leave open gaps between neighboring trees. The cyan player ring stays clear against both grass and stones.
view-04.png.regressions: Some crowns still look repetitive and the beach outline has sharp corners.

view-05.png.evidence: Sharp runway and field boundaries make the scene easy to parse at a glance.
view-05.png.regressions: Objective overlaps aircraft; generic water flecks do little to connect water to shore.

view-06.png.evidence: Deck remains visible through restrained combat particles and aircraft separate against teal water.
view-06.png.regressions: Several aircraft cross the deck or HUD; low resolution merges fine smoke and markings.

view-07.png.evidence: Orange impacts and pale aircraft retain contrast on the fine blue field.
view-07.png.regressions: Deck overlap and softened aircraft details still obscure the immediate target.

view-08.png.evidence: Aircraft on the outside of the swarm remain distinguishable.
view-08.png.regressions: Soft circular particles hide deck features and objectives intersect the scene.

view-09.png.evidence: Wet surface highlights, reflected light, smoke and wreckage reinforce a layered weather scene.
view-09.png.regressions: Small troops and the tank merge with dark ground in parts of the frame.

view-10.png.evidence: Narrow tree shadows fit the crowns and leave the driveway and grass unobscured. The small tree contacts and the longer hangar shadows convey the difference in height.
view-10.png.regressions: Player and hangar still overlap. The large grassy field remains even.

view-11.png.evidence: Subtle dark ripples preserve separation for pale wings, hot impacts and charcoal smoke.
view-11.png.regressions: The main cluster still covers the bow and several aircraft pass beneath the HUD.

view-12.png.evidence: The aircraft ring and beach remain distinct, and fine waves give the open water a more natural surface.
view-12.png.regressions: The softer trees and aircraft edges reduce the sense of scale on land.

view-13.png.evidence: The trees by the service road have close contact shadows that remain readable through the softer raster. Runway threshold paint and aircraft ring still hold their shape.
view-13.png.regressions: The broad grass texture remains soft, and the roof and aircraft still overlap.

view-14.png.evidence: Runway is apparent even with soft output.
view-14.png.regressions: The plane and the objective collide; simplified roofs and mottled ground have little relief.

view-15.png.evidence: Market stalls, detailed paving and long shadows create consistent visual space; route marks remain identifiable.
view-15.png.regressions: Similar dark human silhouettes are easy to lose beside stalls.

view-16.png.evidence: Cream wings and the carrier remain distinct against largely quiet water.
view-16.png.regressions: Bow overlaps several aircraft and soft effects convey little impact.

view-17.png.evidence: Sharp pale aircraft and good carrier markings help separate the formation.
view-17.png.regressions: Water glints resemble tracer flecks; the bow pileup remains ambiguous.

view-18.png.evidence: Open sea separates cleanly from the airfield; plane and navigation arrow remain legible.
view-18.png.regressions: Straight beach edge and soft terrain lose surface definition.

view-19.png.evidence: Large field and sea areas are distinct in layout and color.
view-19.png.regressions: The objective covers the plane and the field grid overwhelms the softer plane silhouette.

view-20.png.evidence: Isolated carrier silhouette and bright deck stripes are distinct.
view-20.png.regressions: Bow aircraft is nearly part of the deck and the rigid rectangular wake flattens the scene.

view-21.png.evidence: Fine ripples, tapered wake and deck markings remain distinct around the orange impacts.
view-21.png.regressions: Bow overlap and the aircraft under the banner still disrupt identification.

view-22.png.evidence: Pale aircraft still show against blue water.
view-22.png.regressions: Deck overlap, a rigid wake, center text and fuzzy circular effects reduce separation.

view-23.png.evidence: Crisp aircraft and facility lines; teal water cleanly separates from grass.
view-23.png.regressions: Beach line is too uniform and detached white flecks give little surf depth.

view-24.png.evidence: Runway markings and pilot ring remain clear. Tightly broken water detail flows into a brighter shallow-water band.
view-24.png.regressions: Soft aircraft and hangar edges overlap, while the land has fairly even illumination.

view-25.png.evidence: Low fog, long shadows and differentiated foliage establish layered terrain.
view-25.png.regressions: Distant troops and some armor merge into the muted haze.

view-26.png.evidence: Soft smoke and bright hits separate from the small-scale water ripples.
view-26.png.regressions: Aircraft overlap and the banner crowd the fight, especially near the bow.

view-27.png.evidence: Sharp runway and neat building silhouettes with useful raised geometry.
view-27.png.regressions: The player merges with a blue roof; broad flat greens and a straight shore lack transition detail.

view-28.png.evidence: Fine broken crests give the deep blue water scale against the carrier and distinguish the soft stern wake.
view-28.png.regressions: Bow aircraft still sits against deck markings and the broad offshore wave direction repeats.

view-29.png.evidence: Even the softer view retains fine dark-water ripples, a distinct stern wake and a legible cyan ring.
view-29.png.regressions: The overlap with the bow and the soft paint marks reduce aircraft definition.

view-30.png.evidence: Subtle dark ripples preserve separation for pale wings, hot impacts and charcoal smoke.
view-30.png.regressions: The main cluster still covers the bow and several aircraft pass beneath the HUD.

view-31.png.evidence: Even the softer view retains fine dark-water ripples, a distinct stern wake and a legible cyan ring.
view-31.png.regressions: The overlap with the bow and the soft paint marks reduce aircraft definition.

view-32.png.evidence: Single carrier and distinct deck markings read quickly against restrained teal water.
view-32.png.regressions: Player nose is close to the bow; the wake is soft and simple.

view-33.png.evidence: Cyan ring separates the aircraft from grass and rocks. Fine water grain supports the surf and depth gradient.
view-33.png.regressions: The angular beach outline and repeating foliage remain visible.

view-34.png.evidence: Pale aircraft stand out over blue water.
view-34.png.regressions: Blocky wake and center overlays disrupt depth; circular particles conceal deck detail.

view-35.png.evidence: Soft smoke and bright hits separate from the small-scale water ripples.
view-35.png.regressions: Aircraft overlap and the banner crowd the fight, especially near the bow.

view-36.png.evidence: Consistent hangar group and runway markings carry the facility read.
view-36.png.regressions: Blue aircraft merges with a similarly colored roof; simple beach and fuzzy scenery.

view-37.png.evidence: Runway orientation and blocks of farmland are quick to recognize.
view-37.png.regressions: Objective overlays the plane; spotted ground, polygonal trees and straight white shore compete.

view-38.png.evidence: Layered silhouettes, glows and cool terrain support a strongly localized explosion.
view-38.png.regressions: The right burst and busy silhouettes conceal some units.

view-39.png.evidence: Fine ripples, tapered wake and deck markings remain distinct around the orange impacts.
view-39.png.regressions: Bow overlap and the aircraft under the banner still disrupt identification.

view-40.png.evidence: Illuminated wall rims and cool room shadows organize a detailed floor plan; colored marks distinguish routes.
view-40.png.regressions: Small markings and dense furniture require a closer look.

view-41.png.evidence: Single light carrier remains easy to locate.
view-41.png.regressions: Blurred bow aircraft merges into the deck; the slab-like wake and center labels flatten the image.

view-42.png.evidence: Tighter tree contacts leave visible grass between the crowns. The plane remains easy to isolate near the beach and the offshore texture supports the surf.
view-42.png.regressions: The softer foliage still loses scale cues. The ground shadow can look detached at individual trees if inspected closely.

view-43.png.evidence: Orange impacts and pale aircraft retain contrast on the fine blue field.
view-43.png.regressions: Deck overlap and softened aircraft details still obscure the immediate target.

view-44.png.evidence: Crisp runway, hangar shadows and muted surf establish a coherent airfield.
view-44.png.regressions: The finer offshore surface occupies little of the frame. The pilot still overlaps the hangar line.

view-45.png.evidence: Crisp deck lines and raised island clarify orientation; short highlights mark the sea.
view-45.png.regressions: Wake remains soft and the player overlaps the bow.
